## Hypothesis

We want to validate the edge of the TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VIX_INTRADAY_MEANREV_SHORT candidate across regime shifts using 16-month OOS real-fills A/B test. The hypothesis is that intraday VIX mean-reversion provides a short bias edge when combined with trendline break structure on SPY calls.

## Mechanism

A/B test comparing baseline engine vs engine with the candidate enabled, using real OPRA fills over 2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18 (16 months), measuring edge_capture on J's anchor days and aggregate Sharpe. Entry: trendline break + VIX intraday mean-reversion signal (VIX pulling back from intraday extreme). Exit: standard chandelier profit-lock + chart stop.
